Definition: properly, something poured out, i.e. a casting (of metal); by implication, a tube (as cast)
BiblicalUsage: Mutsaqah is a casting, a thing poured out — under the brim of the molten sea are knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, cast when it was cast, and Zechariah sees a candlestick of gold with a bowl upon the top of it, and seven pipes to the seven lamps.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the cast work is the temple's quiet witness: even the ornaments are made to last, because the house is God's.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
